Messages.Author: Nosk
Messages.Body:
I have some questions in regards of Shattering Crescendo and possible fizzle scenarios:

A vampire plays Shattering Crescendo at superior melpominee targeting two War Ghouls. The controller of those War Ghouls sacrifices them to burn two different locations.

1. Does the action fizzle? Card says "up to two targets", but targets are chosen when action is declared and they are no longer valid, so I guess it fizzles.

2. In case it fizzels, does the acting vampire controller need to discard a Shattering Crescendo from their hand?

3. In a different scenario, where targets are still valid on resolution, but vampire has lost blood during the action so they cannot pay the blood cost of the action, does another Shattering Crescendo need to be discrded? (similar to question above but different reason)

Thank you

Shattering Crescendo - Action
Protean: Ⓓ Inflict 1 unpreventable damage on an ally or retainer.
Melpominee: Ⓓ Discard a Shattering Crescendo to inflict 2 unpreventable damage on each of up to two minions controlled by a single Methuselah.
Superior Melpominee: As Melpominee above, but for 3 unpreventable damage each.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Nosk wrote:
>
> > Hobbesgoblin wrote:
> > I foudn the aanswer in a different thread
> > www.vekn.net/forum/rules-questions/81642-shattering-crescendo-and-missing-target#112150
> > the action fizzles if there are no targets left.
> >
> Thank you! So now we are sure that the action fizzels if it does not have any valid target.
> But I still have the doubt about discarding the Shattering Crescendo. As far as I know, when an action fizzles, you pay cost as much as you can, but is this also affecting to this discard cost/effect?
>
No, you don't pay anything if there are no valid targets left. You only pay as much as you can when the reason why the action fizzles is because you cannot pay the full cost.

b)
Discarding a card to... (Shattering Crescendo), burning 1 blood to... (Chiroptean Marauder) etc. are not card costs.

Meshenka has to pay 1 blood to play Chiropteran Marauder at superior.

Name: Chiropteran Marauder
Cardtype: Combat
Discipline: Vicissitude
[vic] Maneuver.
[VIC] Burn 1 blood to make the damage from this vampire's hand strikes aggravated this round.

Name: Meshenka
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Tzimisce
Group: 2
Capacity: 8
Discipline: ANI AUS VIC
Sabbat priscus: Cards requiring Vicissitude [vic] cost Meshenka {-1} blood.
